name: Kirkland Signature Panko Battered Tempura Shrimp (Frozen Warning)
whyItWorks: Tail-on shrimp dipped in thick batter and par-fried in vegetable oil. Reheating in the oven produces a crunchy, oil-laden coating that can scrape inflamed tissue and stimulate rapid bile release.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Fried Food Warning: Better to peel off the fried batter coating and consume the tender shrimp meat inside.
